amendsObligations.addRequirement: Cable allowable continuous current Iz uses a separate exact ampacity contract. Cross-section, material, installation method, loaded-conductor count, ambient-temperature factor and grouping factor are explicit evidence-backed inputs; binary floating point and hidden defaults cannot decide Iz.
Ampacity reference row and every correction factor carry immutable evidenceRef/contentHash provenance. Missing factor applicability is unresolved, not factor 1.0.

FA-08 technical cable policy may consume shared AMPACITY_IZ_A evidence, but ampacity PASS remains distinct from connected-load current, voltage drop, short-circuit withstand and ELV7 verified compliance.
Grouping membership is selector-aware: insertion/removal/re-routing of another grouped cable invalidates affected Iz evaluations even when the evaluated cable itself is unchanged.
